name: Brook
description: Wano-cutoff adaptation: no repeat resurrection, transformation, healing, or literal detached-body scouting; sleep, cold and detection are bounded gameplay abstractions.

paths.name: Gentle Blade
paths.description: Quick-draw fencing upgrades improve Brook's timing, precision and interruption potential; numerical values are gameplay adaptations, not manga measurements.

upgrades.name: Veteran's Edge
upgrades.description: Adds a small flat damage bonus to Brook's primary and damaging Techniques.

upgrades.name: Blinking Draw
upgrades.description: Shortens primary timing to reflect Brook's exceptionally rapid iaido attacks.

upgrades.name: Long Cane Reach
upgrades.description: Extends primary contact reach as a gameplay abstraction of Brook's long, precise fencing lines.

upgrades.name: Interrupting Flourish
upgrades.description: Quick-draw impacts can briefly stun eligible weak-willed, stunnable targets.

upgrades.name: Gentle Blade Mastery
upgrades.description: Multiplies Brook's outgoing damage after flat additions.

paths.name: Chills of the Underworld
paths.description: Soul cold becomes bounded pulse control, armor penetration and a non-chaining frost emission; it does not create terrain.

upgrades.name: Cold Awakening
upgrades.description: Primary contacts begin pulsing a short cold stun around the impact.

upgrades.name: Widened Chills
upgrades.description: Replaces the cold pulse with a wider, repeated pulse for clustered eligible targets.

upgrades.name: Soul Solid Edge
upgrades.description: Adds armor ignore to represent Soul Solid cutting unusually hard materials.

upgrades.name: Frozen Ground Line
upgrades.description: Primary contacts emit a bounded frost line away from Brook; it does not trigger other effects or counters.

upgrades.name: Underworld Mastery
upgrades.description: Multiplies Brook's cold-infused outgoing damage after flat additions.

paths.name: Soul King Performance
paths.description: Music, sharp hearing and soul awareness grant detection and retargeting; tempo and damage bonuses abstract performance pressure.

upgrades.name: Resonant Hearing
upgrades.description: Brook detects concealed targets, adapting his documented ability to locate unseen movement by sound.

upgrades.name: Soul-Led Pursuit
upgrades.description: Brook can retarget one lost primary target at resolution instead of restarting the windup.

upgrades.name: Festival Tempo
upgrades.description: Musical tempo improves primary timing only; it does not accelerate Techniques.

upgrades.name: Ghostly Awareness
upgrades.description: Soul-assisted awareness extends primary acquisition reach as a bounded gameplay adaptation.

upgrades.name: Soul King Finale
upgrades.description: A performance-pressure multiplier improves outgoing damage; it is not a new canon attack.
